x: Urry also did well at his first attempt; and in Reeve we have another member who should show up well next season. Churcher's brilliant form earned him first prize in the sealed handicap, with Readman second, and a well-deserving case third.

Of our non-scoring "A" team men, Green gained a first-class standard medal, and Harley and Urry second-class medals. Our "B" team acquitted themselves well in finishing 12th of the 17 teams to close in.

Elson, Heather, Goold, Jarvis, Boddington, Snell Hamer, Spooner, Cornish, Joe Coleman, Earle, Urry, Clark, Pattenden, Willis, True and several others, some beginners, who are showing rapid improvement.
No less meritorious was the walking of W. Urry, who followed Sutton. He, also, was making his first attempt in this race and showed fine judgment.
Bill Urry, as last year, gave a splendid show of even walking and finished tenth in 8 hr. 56 min. 58 sec. He was the first "Service" athlete to finish and, as last year, won the special prize.
Handicap Team: 3, Belgrave H. “ B ” Team, 10.48.08. McGreechan, Frazer, Urry.

Those to have finished the distance inside 9 hours and excluding the performances just quoted are Bellchamber (twice), Miles, Rathbone, Bentley, Martin (R.) (4 times), Bidgood (3 times), Rickards (twice), Urry (twice), Sutton (twice), Baker and Stirling Wakeley.
